news.headline: DOJ orders California counties to set aside suspected noncitizen ballots
news.body: The Justice Department sent letters to multiple California county election offices demanding they identify and set aside mail ballots linked to people it says may be noncitizens. Officials warned counties they could face legal action if they do not comply, while California election authorities said the federal list is unreliable and cannot be used to withhold ballots.
